# Build handover

This file records where the build stopped. `decisions.md` is the authoritative record of decisions. `docs/factoree-sdd.md` is the design, and the specs in `docs/specs/` amend it. SDD §67 defines done. `BUILD.md` is the session prompt.

## Open work

Each item names the SDD section that it affects. The adversarial review of 2026-10-29 found R-1 to R-12 and H-1 to H-5, in order of severity. R-10 and H-3, H-5 to H-15 stay open. The Phase 12 review found H-6 to H-11. Each R item is confirmed in the code.

- R-1 CLOSED by W-3. §35, §40, §44, §68 (decided: `docs/specs/check-isolation.md`): verification, user validation, review and patch capture run in the Sprite after the Implementer, as the same user. `SPRITE_BASE_ENVIRONMENT.PATH` in `fly-sprite-sandbox.ts` starts with directories the agent can write. A shim for `git`, `npm` or the runner CLI fakes every later check and the captured patch. Capture the patch with an absolute git path and a minimal environment first, then run the checks in a fresh Sprite or a restored checkpoint with base SHA plus that patch.
- R-2 CLOSED by W-4. §27, §28, AT-41 (decided: `docs/specs/autonomy-levels.md`): the autonomy level is stored and never read. An L0 pending Product, and an L2 risk-capped issue, both get a full L3 Run and a non-draft PR. `Product.status` is never read at routing. Branch on the level after refinement (L0 stop after context, L1 after verify, L2 draft PR) and refuse a pending Product.
- R-3 CLOSED by W-6. §29, §58: `ActionPolicy.assertAllowed` has no caller. Staging, production and merge rules reach the prompt only, and `src/prompts/implementer.ts` tells the model that Factoree enforces them. Reference repositories are read-only through `chmod`, which the owner can undo. The agent CLIs read the repository `.mcp.json`, `.claude/` and `opencode.json`, so a repository can add MCP servers. Map each action to a mechanism or delete it, and remove the false prompt sentence.
- R-4 CLOSED by W-4. §29: `.factoree/config.yaml` sets `sandbox.allowedDomains`, and `HOST_NAME` in `src/domain/runs/sandbox.ts` accepts `*.com`. A merged agent PR can widen egress for every later Run. Keep the allow list on the Product and let the repository only narrow it.
- R-5 CLOSED by W-2. §52: `SANDBOX_ADAPTER=local` turns on `allowUnenforcedNetwork` in `src/bin/worker.ts`, and `.env.example` ships `local`. The agent then runs as the worker user and can read the worker environment (App private key, secret key, admin token). The `.env.example` placeholders for `ADMIN_API_TOKEN` and `FACTOREE_SECRET_KEY` pass validation.
- R-6 CLOSED by W-2. §52: `GitRepositoryReader.credentialSources` is one map per worker, keyed by origin. All GitHub repositories share one origin, so two tenants that resolve context at the same time mint tokens for each other's installation. The mirror cache is keyed by URL only. Pass the installation per call and key the mirror by tenant.
- R-7 CLOSED by W-2. §52, AT-52: `app-token-provider.ts` mints installation tokens without `repositories`. The clone token reads, and the publish token writes, every repository of the installation. `putGitHubInstallation` moves an installation to another tenant without a check.
- R-8 CLOSED by W-2. §68: the completion invariant reads workflow locals that the control flow already forces, and it runs after the PR and the Proof Pack exist. `refined.status === "needs_input"` with no question hits `break` and continues to implement. Check persisted rows before `publishProofPack`, and fail on the empty question list.
- R-9 CLOSED by W-3. §35, §68 (covered by `docs/specs/check-isolation.md`): the tree that verification tested is not bound to the tree that is published. The validator and the preview run in the primary worktree after verify. Return `worktreeFingerprint` from verify, and require the review before-tree to equal it.
- R-10 AT-35: implement, validate and review use `maximumAttempts: 1`. A worker crash gives a heartbeat timeout that fails the Run with INTERNAL_ERROR, and the CLI process in the Sprite keeps running.
- R-11 CLOSED by W-3. §46 (covered by `docs/specs/check-isolation.md`): `trusted-checkout.ts` passes `...process.env` to git on the worker, so the App key, the secret key and the admin token reach git and its helpers. Pass `PATH`, a temporary `HOME`, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null` and `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`.
- R-12 CLOSED by W-2. §49: two `throw new Error` paths in the workflow re-throw a non-`ApplicationFailure`, so Temporal retries the workflow task for ever while the row says FAILED. Terminal writes do not run in `CancellationScope.nonCancellable`.

- H-1 CLOSED by W-5. §8, §24, §56 (decided: `docs/specs/refiner-agent.md`): refinement, conflict detection and the Validation Contract builder are deterministic (DI-4.1, DI-4.7, DI-6.2). A ticket without acceptance criteria produces questions, not criteria, and an assertion that no rule classifies becomes `manual`, which ends an L3 Run `VALIDATION_MANUAL_REQUIRED` (DI-6.4, DI-7.5). §56 names six prompt files. Three exist, as TypeScript in `src/prompts/`.
- H-2 §31, §37: closed by DI-14.17. A full live Run has not yet exercised it (B-1).
- H-3 §48: SDD §48 lists 18 states. The code adds `BLOCKED_ROUTING`, `BLOCKED_TARGET` and `BLOCKED_STALE_SET` from `docs/specs/multi-repo-tenancy.md` §17, and AT-39 and AT-43 use them. §48 and §49 do not.
- H-4 §4, §71: Change Sets are Version 2 (H-A2). W-7 removed the leftovers.
- H-15 AT-46, AT-47: `buildSiblingCloner` has tests and no production caller. No agent tool exposes `clone_sibling`, and the tenancy spec puts that tool out of scope.
- H-5 §42, §67: DI-3.9 makes every repair a fresh Implementer run. The §67 item "Implementer can resume for repair" is marked PASS in the old audit. `AgentRunner.resume` exists in the interface, and the workflow does not use it.
- H-6 §33: `CliAgentRunner.sessions` is worker-local. On two workers, `completeRun` can run on worker B, and `releaseRun` frees nothing on worker A. Pin a session to its worker, or move session state out of the process.
- H-7 §50: the timeout is checked between stages only. With `IMPLEMENT_MARGIN_MS` of five minutes an agent can run about five minutes past the deadline.
- H-8 §40: a Reviewer that commits and then resets to the original `HEAD`, and deletes its branch, defeats the git-state fingerprint. A reflog read closes it. The guard has no false-positive test.
- H-9 §50: `releaseRun` runs after the durable write in `completeRun`. An `updateStatus` throw keeps the sessions until a retry succeeds.
- H-10 §57: a skill description is attacker-controlled text in the Implementer prompt. Newline collapse and a 300-character cap stop a forged prompt line. In-line instruction text still reaches the model.
- H-11 §60: human-authored goal text is not redacted at every persistence boundary. `LinearEvidenceStorage` has never run against a live account. `head -c N -- path` is not verified on the Fly Sprites base image.

- H-12 §10, §62: the SDD names OpenTelemetry and OTLP. The code uses `prom-client`. No runner gets a model, turn or spend limit. The cost part is CLOSED by `docs/specs/agent-session-usage-and-hangs.md`: the `AgentSession` table holds the tokens and the cost of each agent session, and the Proof Pack shows the totals.
- H-13 CLOSED by W-13. §12: no LICENSE, README, Dockerfile or deploy manifest existed. The release has all of them, the image, the Compose file and the Helm chart.
- H-14 CLOSED by W-11. §10 of `docs/specs/multi-repo-tenancy.md`: `DelegationService` passes `repositoryProposal: null`, so a Product with more than one repository always asks a human for the target.
- H-16 CLOSED by W-11. §46, §50: parallel Runs on one repository. Each Run proves one patch on one base SHA, and the publication check fails it with STALE_BASE when the branch moved (FAC-48, 2026-10-31: a merge into c-dash main during the Run). With several issues worked at once in separate sandboxes, every merge forces each other Run to be delegated again from nothing. The owner wants Runs that do not block each other or stop each other from opening a pull request. Grill: re-verify the same patch on the new base automatically, keep the human answers, and decide when a rebase conflict needs a human.
- H-17 CLOSED by `docs/specs/agent-session-usage-and-hangs.md`. §33, §50: an agent CLI that stops writing output and does not exit hangs the Run until the budget ends. FAC-45, 2026-10-30: the free opencode model hit its quota, `opencode run` logged the error and kept running, and the activity kept heartbeating. Detect a session with no output for a bounded time and end it.
- H-19 Kiln: a rerun of the c-dash preview workflow for the same commit fails with `store: conflict`, because the template `pr-12-0c87198` already exists (2026-10-31). Close and reopen the pull request to rebuild it. The Kiln Action should reuse or replace the template.
- H-18 CLOSED by DI-14.26. §31: the review `git diff --cached` failed with exit code -1 on FAC-49, FAC-50 and FAC-51 (2026-10-31). The cause was not a transient fault: the Sprites exec stream closes before its exit frame when a command prints a large output (a 192 KB diff failed on six of eight tries), and the SDK reports exit code -1. `FlySpriteSandbox.exec` now carries the output through files.

## Do not change

- `failRun` and `cancelRun` cancel the Implementer before `completeRun`, and `completeRun` calls `releaseRun` (DI-12.3). Do not reorder them.
- `worktreeFingerprint` returns the tree SHA that `publishing.activities` compares to `patch.treeSha` (DI-12.4). Do not change its return value.
- `CATEGORY_BY_REASON` is a total `Record` (DI-12.1). Classify a new failure reason. Do not make the type partial.
- The ESLint ignore list is narrow. Do not widen `tests/live/*.mjs` to `**/*.mjs`.
- The workflow never calls `destroySandbox`. The Sprite reaper deletes Sprites after retention. `harness.destroyed` is never populated, so do not assert on it.
- Every sandbox create and delete goes through `SettingsSandbox`, which keeps the `SandboxLease` rows (DI-15.14). A path that calls a provider adapter directly breaks the `sandboxMaxLive` count.
- A Run holds its `maxConcurrentRuns` slot until its status is terminal (DI-15.13). Every end of the workflow must still write a terminal status through `completeRun`.

## Known test behaviour

- The integration suite drives a real Chromium. Run `npx playwright install chromium` once per machine, as CI does.
- Never run two suites at the same time. Another project's testcontainers on the same Docker daemon can reset the shared PostgreSQL connection (`read ECONNRESET`), so rerun the stage alone before you debug it. Docker and Temporal test servers compete, and a whole verification run was lost this way.
- `vitest.integration.config.ts` runs `tests/integration` and `tests/acceptance` with one PostgreSQL container per run. `global-setup.ts` migrates a template database, and each test gets a copy.
- `vitest.workflow.config.ts` bundles the two workflows once in `global-setup.ts`. The workflow suite takes about 140 s.
- The time-skipping test environment skips a workflow timer only while the test awaits `handle.result()`. A test that polls a query with `waitFor` across a `condition` timeout waits in real time.
- `waitFor` in `tests/workflow/support/harness.ts` takes an optional `describe` callback. On a timeout it reports the poll count and the last observed value.
- `npx prisma generate` needs a `FACTOREE_DATABASE_URL`. Any value works.
- A pipeline hides the exit code of the command before it. `just verify` runs each stage alone and returns a real aggregate exit code.

## Laptop flow

- Node 24 LTS. `.nvmrc` names 24. The justfile puts `/opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin` first on `PATH`.
- `just install`, `just up`, `just migrate`, `just temporal`, then `just worker` and `just api` in their own terminals. `.env` holds infrastructure only (`.env.example`).
- On a fresh database the API log line `setup is not complete. Open <url>/setup and enter the setup token <token>` names a one-time setup token. Open `FACTOREE_PUBLIC_URL/setup` and enter it. Setup stores the GitHub App, the Linear app, the sandbox provider and the first Product. After setup, sign in with Linear. Scripts send an API key from the API keys screen as `Authorization: Bearer`.
- `just gen` writes `api/openapi.json` and the UI client in `ui/src/api`. `ui/` is its own npm project: `npm ci --prefix ui`.
- `just image` builds `factoree:dev` from the working tree. `deploy/compose/compose.yml` runs it with `FACTOREE_IMAGE=factoree:dev`.
- `docs/quickstart.md` runs one live local Run. `docs/live-acceptance.md` holds the three live profiles (`local`, `sprite`, `full`). Only `full` is §66 proof.

## Test layout

- Unit: `tests/unit`, no Docker.
- Integration and acceptance: `tests/integration` and `tests/acceptance`, PostgreSQL in testcontainers. `tests/acceptance/at-NN-*.test.ts` covers SDD §64 test AT-NN. `phase-NN-exit.test.ts` covers the exit condition of SDD §69 phase NN.
- Workflow: `tests/workflow`, the Temporal test environment.
- Live: `tests/live`, run by `npm run acceptance:live` only.
- Shared doubles: `tests/support`.

## How to run checks

- `just verify` is the gate: lint, typecheck, unit, build, ui-lint, ui-build, gen-check, integration and workflow, one stage at a time. `npm run verify` stops at the first failing stage.
- CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs `npm ci --prefix ui`, then `npm run verify` after `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`.
